<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="lZ8myVxuLmie5zma9K4z"> <mxGraphModel dx="1001" dy="1125" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
class Destination {
 - id: int
 - name: str
 - country: str
 - description: str
 - base_cost: float
 - is_active: bool
 + validate(): void
 + retire(): void
 + reactivate(): void
}

class TravelPackage {
 - id: int
 - name: str
 - description: str
 - is_active: bool
 + validate_itinerary(): void
}

class ItineraryStop {
 - id: int
 - visit_order: int
 + change_order(new_order: int): void
}

class PackageDeparture {
 - id: int
 - start_date: date
 - end_date: date
 - price: float
 - max_capacity: int
 + calculate_available_seats(): int
}

class Customer {
 - id: int
 - full_name: str
 - email: str
 - password_hash: str
 - role: str
}

class Reservation {
 - id: int
 - reserved_at: datetime
 - contracted_unit_price: float
 - status: str
}

class ReservationPassenger {
 - id: int
 - passenger_name: str
 - document_id: str
 - trip_status: str
}

TravelPackage \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" ItineraryStop : includes
Destination \"1\" <-- \"0..*\" ItineraryStop : used in
TravelPackage \"1\" o-- \"0..*\" PackageDeparture : scheduled as
Customer \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Reservation : books
PackageDeparture \"1\" -- \"0..*\" Reservation : receives
Reservation \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" ReservationPassenger : carries
@enduml",
 "config": null
